title: Understanding the Parameter Vector
text: The parameter vector \(\hat{\theta}\) is derived from the design matrix \(X\). Consider how the dimensions of \(X\) influence the length of \(\hat{\theta}\).

title: Invertibility of X
text: For a unique solution in OLS, \(X\) does not need to be invertible. Instead, \(X**TX\) should be invertible. Consider why this is the case.

title: Loss Function Options
text: OLS typically uses the Mean Squared Error (MSE) as the loss function. However, consider if Mean Absolute Error (MAE) could also be used in this context.

title: Minimizing Residuals
text: OLS minimizes the sum of squared residuals, not just the sum of residuals. Think about the difference between these two concepts.

hintAnswer: The length of the parameter vector \(\hat{\theta}\) is equal to \(n\).
title: Determining the Length of \(\hat{\theta}\)
text: Given that \(X\) is an \(m\) by \(n\) matrix, what is the length of the parameter vector \(\hat{\theta}\)?
